item.title: As OpenAI files for IPO, Sam Altman’s eye-scanning company is doing layoffs, report says
item.description: Tools for Humanity, Sam Altman's identity verification company, is reportedly struggling to generate revenue and will downsize its staff.

item.title: Apple’s WWDC AI demos looked more real after $250M false ad settlement
item.description: The vibe of Apple's 2026 WWDC keynote felt like a spouse proudly listing all the honey-do-list items tackled. One subtle example: the many AI demos of someone standing, phone in hand.

item.title: OpenAI files confidentially for IPO, following Anthropic
item.description: The filing comes a little more than a week after its main rival, Anthropic, also filed to go public, ramping up the race between the two AI firms.

item.title: Apple plays catch-up at WWDC
item.description: Apple spent much of its WWDC keynote highlighting fixes, performance improvements, and long-requested features before unveiling its upgraded AI-powered Siri, signaling that the company wants users to see AI as just one part of a broader effort to improve its software.

item.title: Apple bets cheaper AI will woo small developers
item.description: As AI experimentation grows more expensive, Apple is waiving cloud API costs for developers with fewer than 2 million first-time App Store downloads.

item.title: WWDC 2026: Everything announced on Siri AI, iOS 27, Apple Intelligence and more
item.description: Apple primarily made the case for an improved experience with its longstanding Siri assistant, which like most other announcements had a hefty helping of AI.

item.title: Apple just taught your iPhone to finish your sentences, your photos, and your workflows
item.description: Apple is adding new AI-powered features to Safari, Shortcuts, and Password apps.

item.title: Apple will let you build workflows using AI in its new Shortcuts app
item.description: Shortcuts gets an AI upgrade, letting you describe the workflow you want in a prompt.

item.title: Apple’s Image Playground doesn’t suck anymore

item.title: Apple’s Photos app is getting new AI editing features

item.title: Apple is fixing the headache of splitting the bill with its new Siri in Camera feature
item.description: "If you're grabbing a bite with friends and point your iPhone at the bill, then [you can] select what you ordered to split the tab with Apple Cash," said Apple VP of Software Sebastien Marineau-Mes.

item.title: Apple’s long-awaited AI Siri overhaul is finally here
item.description: The idea behind the new "Siri AI" is to turn the assistant from a voice controlled assistant into an AI companion that can do a lot more.

item.title: Amazon now lets you design custom merch using AI
item.description: A new feature in the Amazon Shopping app allows users to generate designs with Alexa, then print them on products like T-shirts, hoodies, and tumblers.
